newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - GreenPoint target raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - GreenPoint target raised.

text.p: -- Ryan, Beck & Co said it raised earnings estimates and the target price for GreenPoint Financial Corp

-- Ryan, Beck said after better-than-expected Q3 earnings of $0.79 per share, it raised the 1996 EPS estimate to $3.05 from $2.95 and raised the 1997 estimate to $3.85 from $3.20. The analyst also began a 1998 estimate of $4.50 per share. He raised his target to $48 per share from $38 based on the higher earnings estimates and prospects for future growth
-- GreenPoint off 3/8 to 43-1/2 in early trading
